svg.title: British Columbia Forests — corrected oval reconstruction
svg.desc: Reference-based SVG reconstruction checked against the supplied 676 × 945 PNG. Named layers, solid vector fills and Bézier paths; no embedded bitmap, linked asset or font dependency. This is not a verified official master.
svg.metadata: Reconstruction from supplied PNG. Frame rebuilt as fitted ellipses. Eagle, separate foreground firs, distant treeline, elk, fish and glyphs refitted as vector Bézier paths. Raster is not embedded. Layer order preserves overlapping foreground trees over the distant woodland. Letterforms are outlines, not an identified font.
